member.name: T:HumanGateway.Relay.Api.RelayJson
member.summary: JSON configuration for the Relay's HTTP API. Mirrors ProtocolJson.Options (exact enum tokens, omit-null, disallow unmapped members) and additionally applies a camelCase naming policy so plain request/response records share the protocol's wire convention without each needing an explicit [JsonPropertyName]. Protocol entities are unaffected: their explicit [JsonPropertyName] attributes override the policy, so an entity response is byte-identical to the protocol wire form.

member.name: T:HumanGateway.Relay.Storage.RelayDbContext
member.summary: The Cloud Relay's durable PostgreSQL store (RELAY-FR-01): gateways, conversations, messages, deliveries, artifacts (metadata + BYTEA blobs), participants, and the sync model (inbox, idempotency, cursors). Protocol envelopes are stored as canonical wire JSON in jsonb columns with denormalised scalar columns for indexed querying. Column names follow snake_case (PostgreSQL convention); the design-time factory in keeps the EF tooling able to build the model without a live database.
